item.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Conversational AI - Services Special Projects - Apple
item.description:
Summary
At Apple, great ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We're building a massive, real-time conversational experience from the ground up, one that will reach users at Apple scale. It sits at the intersection of Generative AI, Information Retrieval, and Knowledge Graphs. We're looking for a senior machine learning engineer to own the conversational intelligence layer: the agent's reasoning and tool-calling, the low-latency LLM inference behind it, and the knowledge services that keep every response accurate and grounded. You'll partner closely with teams across Apple to bring it to production.
Description
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who has shipped conversational AI and LLM systems to production and cares about latency as much as model quality. You'll work closely with AI/ML scientists and engineers across the stack. You'll design multi-turn conversational experiences, build agent logic that plans and calls tools, and develop query understanding models that turn natural language into structured intent. You'll also make large and small models fast and cost-efficient enough to serve in real time. Just as importantly, you'll help make sure every response is accurate and grounded. You'll build and scale knowledge graph services that resolve, enrich, and expand user requests with low latency and also connect the system to real-time data sources so its answers stay current. Finally, you'll build the evaluation that keeps all of it honest: automated and LLM-as-judge evaluation for multi-turn conversations, built into the development workflow so regressions are caught before they reach users.
Minimum Qualifications
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field * 7+ years of experience as a software or machine learning engineer, with a significant focus on conversational AI, search, or LLM-powered systems * Strong programming skills in Go and Python, plus at least one of Java or Scala * Hands-on experience building and shipping conversational AI or dialogue systems: intent and slot understanding, multi-turn context management, clarification, and disambiguation * Experience building LLM-powered applications in production, including prompt design, tool/function calling, structured output generation, and agentic orchestration patterns * Demonstrated LLM inference-optimization experience: distillation, quantization, batching, KV-cache tuning, caching, and profiling to find real bottlenecks rather than guessing at them * Hands-on experience deploying and serving LLMs or ML models directly in the production request path, using serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, Triton, or TorchServe * Experience with knowledge graphs and low-latency lookup and retrieval services * Fluency with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (transformers, PEFT) * Familiarity with cloud environments (including AWS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) * Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
Preferred Qualifications
* Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field * Experience fine-tuning and distilling LLMs for task-specific use, such as query parsing, classification, and response generation, using techniques such as LoRA/adapters and teacher/student setups * Experience designing knowledge graph schemas, building graph compilation and ingestion pipelines, and working with graph databases such as TigerGraph or Neo4j * Deep experience with KV stores and in-memory serving for low-latency lookups (e.g., Cassandra, Redis, SSTables) * Experience calibrating LLM judges against human judgments for multi-turn conversations, including inter-annotator agreement and judge reliability tracking * Experience with personalization and memory in conversational systems, and applying privacy principles such as data minimization and on-device processing * Experience implementing safety guardrails for LLM-powered agents, including prompt-injection defenses and adversarial evaluation * Familiarity with experiment tracking and data/model versioning tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) * Deep understanding of distributed systems and service design, and experience architecting and leading projects with cross-functional stakeholders * Published work or patents in conversational AI, information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or efficient inference

Join Sales AI as an Applied Scientist and own the science behind how Amazon Ads helps every advertiser grow, from understanding where each brand is on its growth journey to building the GenAI agents account teams use every day.
Advertising is one of the fastest growing parts of our business, and science sits at the heart of how we help brands succeed. Our scientists work on two connected problems. The first is figuring out, for each brand, the smartest next step it can take to grow, and turning that into a clear, personalized recommendation. * Turn ambiguous business problems into well-defined science problems, and choose the right approach to solve them * Build, ship, and continuously improve models in production, and own their quality once they launch * Measure whether our models really move the business, through A/B tests, causal analysis, and offline evaluation * Partner with engineers and product managers to take ideas from early research into production * Set the technical direction for your area, raise the scientific bar, and mentor other scientists * Explain complex methods and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners, and sales leaders
